h2: Water Heater Repair & Installation Kuta & Legian
intro: If your hot water has gone cold, I handle Water Heater Repair & Installation Kuta & Legian — electric tanks, gas units, and rooftop solar alike. Send a few photos on WhatsApp and I'll work out whether it's a burnt element, a tripping thermostat, or something deeper in the decades-old pipework.

sections.h3: Why Heaters Fail Faster Here Than Inland
sections.text: Kuta and Legian sit close enough to the beach that salt-laden air eats through metal fittings quicker than you'd expect further inland. Add original pipework from decades ago in older homes around Tuban and Jl. Padma, and every unit runs under constant stress. Low-lying lanes also flood during heavy rain, which can short connections behind the tank. That combination means most failures here are accelerated by the environment rather than simple age.

sections.h3: The Jobs I See Most in This Stretch
sections.text: Guesthouses and small hotels along Kuta Beach road generate the bulk of my calls: a heater that simply won't heat, one tripping the breaker mid-shower, visible leaks at the tank base or pipe joints, and rooftop solar delivering only lukewarm water even on clear days. With many rooms cycling hot water daily, elements, thermostats, anodes, and mixers all wear through faster than in newer single-family builds.

sections.h3: What to Send Me on WhatsApp
sections.text: Before I head over, snap a few photos: the heater itself with its brand plate if readable, any corrosion or dripping you can spot, and the breaker panel if it's been tripping. Mention whether the unit is electric, gas, or solar, roughly how old it looks, and which bathroom it feeds. That gives me enough to put together a fair quote for your specific job — no guesswork, no fixed rate sheet.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Heater Alive in Coastal Air
sections.text: Because salt air near Kuta Beach corrodes exposed parts, check the anode rod every six months and wipe down fittings after particularly humid weeks. If your property sits in one of the lower lanes prone to flooding, confirm the electrical connection box is sealed and raised above typical water levels. For rooftop solar units, a quick visual pass over the tank and pipework each season catches small seeps before they turn into costly repairs.

faq.q: How much will my repair cost?
faq.a: It depends entirely on the job — a simple element swap is very different from a full replacement. Send photos on WhatsApp and I'll give you an accurate quote based on what I see.

faq.q: Do you cover both electric and gas heaters, plus new installs?
faq.a: Yes. Electric storage tanks, gas instant heaters, and rooftop solar systems are all within scope, including brand-new installations in villas and guesthouses across Kuta, Legian, and Tuban.

faq.q: My heater trips the breaker every shower. Should I just keep resetting it?
faq.a: A repeated trip usually signals a shorted element or moisture behind the unit, especially after one of those heavy-rain floods. It's worth getting inspected rather than cycling the breaker indefinitely.
